name: notice-board-visit-host-draw-capped-v1
description: ⭐ THE HOST-DRAW CAP: S17 WITH A HOST PAID AT MOST ONCE BETWEEN THEIR OWN TURNS, however many neighbours visit them in the meantime. ⛔ ITS CONTROL AND ITS PAIRED ARM IS overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-v1.overlay.json, AND THE TWO DIFFER IN EXACTLY ONE LEAF: rules.turn.hostDrawCapPerRound, false against true. Everything else in this file is that arm pinned leaf for leaf, which in turn is the two-board arm pinned leaf for leaf, so the three read as a chain and every delta between adjacent columns is one rule. Run all three paired on identical reference-v15 seeds. ⛔ WHY IT EXISTS: THE FOUR-SEAT BREACH, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING BLOCKING A RULE A TABLE HAS ALREADY LIKED. S17 was ruled in from a two-player table on 11/09/2026 and it takes the bonus slot OUT OF DEAN'S BAND AT FOUR SEATS ALONE: 64.9% of turns against a 60% ceiling, where the one-leaf control reads 59.9% and two and three seats barely move (43.1% against 44.0%, 49.0% against 49.2%). The mechanism is legible: the faucet SCALES WITH THE NUMBER OF RIVALS, because a seat is visited once per rival per round, and each card handed back makes the next visit easier to afford. A cap per host per round is the shape that stops it scaling. ⛔ READ 4p FIRST. ⚠️ "PER ROUND" IS THE HOST'S OWN TURN CYCLE AND NOT THE VISITOR'S TURN, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE KNOB. A cap on the VISITOR'S turn would bite only when one visitor sends two visits to the same host in a single turn, which is reachable at TWO SEATS ALONE (A Helping Hand against a rival holding two boards, itself only reachable since the two-board fix), and would therefore leave four seats - the only breaching seat count - completely untouched. The engine clears the latch when the HOST'S own turn begins, and the latch lives on the SEAT rather than on TurnState, which turn end replaces wholesale. ⛔ THE PREDICTION, WRITTEN DOWN BEFORE THE RUN SO THAT IT CAN BE SCORED RATHER THAN RETROFITTED: THIS IS EXPECTED TO BE INSUFFICIENT ON ITS OWN. Measured host draws per host per round under the uncapped arm are 0.489 / 0.553 / 0.787 by seat count (a21-host-draw), so a cap of one can only remove the rounds that carried TWO OR MORE - at most 21% / 24% / 31% of the faucet on a Poisson upper bound, and less than that in truth, because the bots choose targets and therefore spread visits rather than piling on, which makes the arrival distribution UNDER-dispersed relative to Poisson. The faucet buys 5.0 points at four seats (59.9 to 64.9), so a 31% cut returns about 1.5 points and lands near 63.4%, STILL OVER THE CEILING. ⭐ IF THE RUN READS MUCH BETTER THAN 63%, THE ARRIVALS ARE MORE CLUSTERED THAN POISSON AND THAT IS THE FINDING - it would mean bots pile onto one popular host far more than the target-spreading story predicts, which bears on the random board's concentration reading (busiest board 57.9% of its game's placements) as well as on this cap. ⚠️ AND IF IT LANDS NEAR 63% AS PREDICTED, THE CAP IS NOT THE ANSWER AND THE CHOICE NARROWS TO THREE: a seat-count-shaped host draw (pay at two and three seats and not at four, the same shape rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats already uses), accepting four seats out of band on the table's evidence, or re-reading the ceiling itself. ⛔ NOTE THE CONTROL HAS NO HEADROOM EITHER: it reads 59.9% at four seats, ONE TENTH OF A POINT INSIDE THE CEILING, so the structural finding may be that NO card faucet fits at four seats rather than that this one is too big. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME, because the 05/09/2026 lesson is that ruling an arm in rules in its whole bundle. TWENTY LEAVES: the nineteen of the host-draw arm, unchanged, plus this one. THE NEW LEAF: rules.turn.hostDrawCapPerRound true, and the ONLY difference from the control. The other nineteen are listed in full in the control's own description and are not restated here, so that the two files cannot drift: read them there. ⚠️ THE MEASUREMENT CAVEAT OF THE PARENT ARM CARRIES UNCHANGED AND IS IF ANYTHING SHARPER HERE: THE SIMULATOR CANNOT MEASURE THE EFFECT DEAN LIKED. The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none, so the instrument clips exactly the extra cards in hand that relieved the tightness - and 26.1% of turns began AT the bound under the uncapped arm against 12.3% under the two-board control. THIS ARM REMOVES CARDS, so its clipping should fall back toward the control's, which makes it MORE comparable to the control and LESS comparable to the arm it is paired against. ⛔ Read the clipping line on a21 before quoting any small delta on this pair, and no report of any arm in this family may be quoted as evidence about tightness in either direction. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds). A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. Stay on reference-v15; cut reference-v16 only when Dean rules an arm in. ⛔ AND ONLY REPORTS FROM THE SAME BOT BATCH MAY BE COMPARED: the bots changed four times on 11/09/2026, and the pair this arm belongs to is the 17:20 control and the 17:23 arm. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the coins arm's two sinks, the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace, rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.dairyGrowsBuilt were removed with the delivery spaces and the Dairy board's Grow. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level. ⛔ WHEAT BOARD RETEXT PINNED 19/09/2026: Dean retexted the Wheat Notice Board (sheet v44) to "Harvest one of your buildings, even if it is 1 card short of full", dropped the hand-to-barn rider (wheatBarn 0) and moved the harvest gate from 'loaded' to 'nearFull'. This overlay predates it and V12 The Auction House ("Discard a card from your Barn. Perform the Notice Board action of that crop") reaches the same power as a card effect under ANY visit currency, so both leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-retext values (wheatBarn 1, wheatHarvestGate 'loaded') and it still replays its own game.
